answer: Require every agent to forge a ferrous badge before it can trade: earned only by useful work checked by unrelated veterans, it cannot be bought, copied or transferred, so each identity carries real cost. Once forged, the agent must keep a lantern signal alive, publishing proof of recent work at unpredictable intervals; a dark lantern freezes its reputation until work resumes. Standing vests slowly, like a glacier releasing water, so mass identities stay worthless. Sybil farms must forge a badge, tend a lantern and wait out the thaw for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
